fact: ITWeb Africa reports Huawei launched the Women in Tech Namibia initiative and the 2026 National Talent Cultivation Project (about 1,000 students), which the ICT minister welcomed as supporting government efforts on digital inclusion and ICT skills.

NUST says Huawei and partners launched the Women in Tech Namibia National Talent Cultivation Programme at the 13 May 2026 Huawei ICT Congress, committing to support 1,000 women in technology over five years with women-focused digital skills training.

fact: NDP6 includes gender-responsive and youth-focused digital training programmes as part of its digital package.
ICT Minister Emma Theofelus highlighted Project 1000, which aims to develop young people's digital skills and connect beneficiaries with employment opportunities.

Namibia's Ministry of Information and Communication Technology says its free nationwide Digital Literacy Programme, launched July 2023, had certified over 900 participants across the fourteen regions by January 2025.

The Ministry of ICT's Hardap office launched a two-week digital literacy course in Maltahohe for 20 participants from 27 July 2026, under its Digital Computer Literacy Programme launched in 2023 for rural communities.
